clauses.quote: The employee must furnish evidence that all of the degree requirements have been met.
Lane change credit shall be given for credit from Salt Lake Community College.
Application for lane advancement on the salary schedule must be made on the official form provided by the Human Resources office (see Appendix C.)
clauses.subject_text: Application for lane advancement on the salary schedule

clauses.quote: Applications must be supported by complete official transcripts of credit (report cards will not suffice), verifying the credit requested.

The total amount paid for the year from the new lane will be prorated based upon the number of contract working days remaining as of the date when all necessary materials are received by the Human Resources office.
clauses.subject_text: The total amount paid for the year from the new lane

clauses.quote: Upon recommendation of the Educator Support and Development office, non-CACTUS credit may be used toward any one-lane advancement on the salary schedule.
All CACTUS approved in-service credit will count towards lane change.
Evidence of credit (e.g. transcripts, USOE CACTUS report, etc.) is to be submitted to Human Resources,
clauses.subject_text: Evidence of credit (e.g. transcripts, USOE CACTUS report, etc.)
clauses.notes: ‘is to be’ functions as a duty.

clauses.quote: Lane change appeals will be directed to the Human Resources office.
Paychecks will be made available to employees on the last district working day of each month, except as may be otherwise provided below.
